news.headline: Bears QB Williams unsure if he's playing, has to still go through protocols
news.detail: Caleb Williams reached another milestone in his recovery from a hamstring injury, logging full participation in practice for the first time since Sept. 18.

news.headline: Questionable (Hamstring)
news.detail: Williams is trending in the right direction but there are still some hurdles he'll need to clear before he's plugged back into the lineup. He told reporters Thursday, after logging a full practice, that he suffered a hamstring tear in Week 2 against the Vikings. Provided that Williams can pass a bat
